cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12)
project(GetDAQIceCompatibility LANGUAGES C CXX)
# 独立可选的历史兼容构建；不进入 Qt 或高速数据程序的链接依赖。
if(NOT UNIX)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "This optional compatibility build currently targets Linux/macOS only")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(ARCHIVES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../archives")
set(VENDOR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/vendor")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${VENDOR}")
function(unpack archive digest folder)
  file(SHA256 "${ARCHIVES}/${archive}" actual)
  if(NOT actual STREQUAL digest)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Checksum mismatch: ${archive}")
  endif()
  if(NOT EXISTS "${VENDOR}/${folder}/.getdaq-unpacked")
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${VENDOR}/${folder}")
    execute_process(COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E tar xzf "${ARCHIVES}/${archive}" WORKING_DIRECTORY "${VENDOR}" RESULT_VARIABLE result)
    if(NOT result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Cannot extract ${archive}")
    endif()
    file(WRITE "${VENDOR}/${folder}/.getdaq-unpacked" "${digest}\n")
  endif()
endfunction()
# Curated Ice compiler/runtime sources; no dependency on historical source/.
set(ICE_BUNDLE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../legacy-get/ice")
if(NOT EXISTS "${ICE_BUNDLE}/cpp/src/Ice/CommunicatorI.cpp")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Project-local legacy Ice source bundle is missing")
endif()
file(COPY "${ICE_BUNDLE}/" DESTINATION "${VENDOR}/ice-40aac3604b78513769adfa9246cc8afdb9287bc1")
unpack(bzip2-1.0.8.tar.gz ab5a03176ee106d3f0fa90e381da478ddae405918153cca248e682cd0c4a2269 bzip2-1.0.8)
unpack(mcpp-2.7.2-4ice-671886cb.tar.gz 51b62655b29fddb7074b2e644f018b800d32456f7204c6c94bbcfa28c1963a27 mcpp-671886cbac088e86c5eaa520322effb86e673bb2)
set(ICE "${VENDOR}/ice-40aac3604b78513769adfa9246cc8afdb9287bc1")
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../tools/prepare-ice-platform.py" "${ICE_BUNDLE}/cpp/include/IceUtil/Config.h")
execute_process(COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../tools/prepare-ice-platform.py"
  --source "${ICE_BUNDLE}/cpp/include/IceUtil/Config.h" --destination "${ICE}/cpp/include/IceUtil/Config.h"
  RESULT_VARIABLE platform_patch)
if(NOT platform_patch EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Cannot prepare legacy Ice CPU definitions")
endif()
set(MCPP "${VENDOR}/mcpp-671886cbac088e86c5eaa520322effb86e673bb2")
set(BZIP "${VENDOR}/bzip2-1.0.8")
set(GENERATED "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${GENERATED}/Ice")
add_library(compat-bzip STATIC ${BZIP}/blocksort.c ${BZIP}/huffman.c ${BZIP}/crctable.c ${BZIP}/randtable.c ${BZIP}/compress.c ${BZIP}/decompress.c ${BZIP}/bzlib.c)
target_include_directories(compat-bzip PUBLIC "${BZIP}")
add_library(compat-mcpp STATIC ${MCPP}/directive.c ${MCPP}/eval.c ${MCPP}/expand.c ${MCPP}/main.c ${MCPP}/mbchar.c ${MCPP}/support.c ${MCPP}/system.c)
target_include_directories(compat-mcpp PRIVATE "${MCPP}")
file(GLOB util_sources "${ICE}/cpp/src/IceUtil/*.cpp")
add_library(compat-IceUtil STATIC ${util_sources})
target_include_directories(compat-IceUtil PUBLIC "${ICE}/cpp/include" PRIVATE "${ICE}/cpp/src")
target_compile_definitions(compat-IceUtil PUBLIC ICE_STATIC_LIBS)
target_link_libraries(compat-IceUtil PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  target_link_libraries(compat-IceUtil PUBLIC rt)
endif()
file(GLOB slice_sources "${ICE}/cpp/src/Slice/*.cpp")
add_library(compat-Slice STATIC ${slice_sources})
target_include_directories(compat-Slice PUBLIC "${ICE}/cpp/src")
target_link_libraries(compat-Slice PUBLIC compat-IceUtil compat-mcpp)
add_executable(slice2cpp ${ICE}/cpp/src/slice2cpp/Gen.cpp ${ICE}/cpp/src/slice2cpp/Main.cpp)
target_include_directories(slice2cpp PRIVATE "${ICE}/cpp/src/slice2cpp")
target_link_libraries(slice2cpp PRIVATE compat-Slice)
file(GLOB ice_interfaces "${ICE}/slice/Ice/*.ice")
set(generated_sources)
set(generated_headers)
foreach(interface IN LISTS ice_interfaces)
  get_filename_component(name "${interface}" NAME_WE)
  list(APPEND generated_sources "${GENERATED}/Ice/${name}.cpp")
  list(APPEND generated_headers "${GENERATED}/Ice/${name}.h")
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${GENERATED}/Ice/${name}.cpp" "${GENERATED}/Ice/${name}.h"
    COMMAND slice2cpp --ice --include-dir Ice --dll-export ICE_API "-I${ICE}/slice" --output-dir "${GENERATED}/Ice" "${interface}"
    DEPENDS slice2cpp ${ice_interfaces} VERBATIM)
endforeach()

add_custom_target(compat-ice-headers DEPENDS ${generated_headers})
file(GLOB ice_sources "${ICE}/cpp/src/Ice/*.cpp")
list(REMOVE_ITEM ice_sources "${ICE}/cpp/src/Ice/DLLMain.cpp")
add_library(compat-Ice STATIC ${ice_sources} ${generated_sources})
add_dependencies(compat-Ice compat-ice-headers)
target_include_directories(compat-Ice PUBLIC "${GENERATED}" PRIVATE "${ICE}/cpp/src")
target_link_libraries(compat-Ice PUBLIC compat-IceUtil compat-bzip ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
foreach(target compat-IceUtil compat-Slice slice2cpp compat-Ice)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
endforeach()

# 原始接口只读，生成产物全部留在构建目录，保留原有 include 层级。
get_filename_component(REPOSITORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(MDAQ "${REPOSITORY}/third_party/legacy-get/mdaq/src")
set(GET "${REPOSITORY}/third_party/legacy-get/getbench/src")
file(GLOB_RECURSE get_interfaces "${MDAQ}/*.ice" "${GET}/*.ice")

set(get_sources)
set(get_headers)
foreach(interface IN LISTS get_interfaces)
  file(RELATIVE_PATH relative "${MDAQ}" "${interface}")
  if(relative MATCHES "^\\.\\.")
    file(RELATIVE_PATH relative "${GET}" "${interface}")
  endif()
  get_filename_component(directory "${relative}" DIRECTORY)
  get_filename_component(name "${relative}" NAME_WE)
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${GENERATED}/${directory}")
  list(APPEND get_sources "${GENERATED}/${directory}/${name}.cpp")
  list(APPEND get_headers "${GENERATED}/${directory}/${name}.h")
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${GENERATED}/${directory}/${name}.cpp" "${GENERATED}/${directory}/${name}.h"
    COMMAND slice2cpp "-I${MDAQ}" "-I${GET}" "-I${ICE}/slice"
      --include-dir "${directory}" --output-dir "${GENERATED}/${directory}" "${interface}"
    DEPENDS slice2cpp ${get_interfaces} VERBATIM)
endforeach()
add_custom_target(compat-get-headers DEPENDS ${get_headers})
add_library(compat-GET STATIC ${get_sources})
add_dependencies(compat-GET compat-get-headers compat-ice-headers)
target_link_libraries(compat-GET PUBLIC compat-Ice)
target_compile_options(compat-GET PRIVATE -Wno-deprecated-declarations)

# Narrow read-only helper; deliberately excludes all retired hardware writers.
add_executable(getdaq-cobo-info "${REPOSITORY}/apps/coboinfo/main.cpp")
target_include_directories(getdaq-cobo-info PRIVATE "${GENERATED}" "${ICE}/cpp/include")
target_link_libraries(getdaq-cobo-info PRIVATE compat-GET)
target_compile_options(getdaq-cobo-info PRIVATE -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
option(GETDAQ_BUILD_COBO_INFO_FIXTURE "Build loopback-only CoBo metadata test fixture" OFF)
if(GETDAQ_BUILD_COBO_INFO_FIXTURE)
  add_executable(cobo-info-fixture "${REPOSITORY}/tests/cobo_info_fixture.cpp")
  target_include_directories(cobo-info-fixture PRIVATE "${GENERATED}" "${ICE}/cpp/include")
  target_link_libraries(cobo-info-fixture PRIVATE compat-GET)
  target_compile_options(cobo-info-fixture PRIVATE -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
endif()
